core_obligations: Diagonal trick: f is a monomorphism iff Delta: X -> X x_Y X is an isomorphism; the diagonal of X_0/Y_0 is locally of finite presentation and the self-product is qcqs.
Conclusion: descend-isomorphism makes Delta_i an isomorphism for some i; then f_i is a monomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Hypotheses of the isomorphism engine for the diagonal.
difficulty_reason: Monomorphism iff diagonal isomorphism (citation); the diagonal is lfp and the self-product qcqs (citations); descend-isomorphism gives the eventual isomorphism of diagonals. The diagonal trick is the content.
